paper_title: Constraining the photon coupling of ultra-light dark-matter axion-like particles by polarization variations of parsec-scale jets in active galaxies
suggested_experiment_name: MOJAVE VLBA AGN jet polarization (Ivanov et al.)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 as plotted on the y-axis of Figure 6 (95% CL upper limit, kappa=1)
notes: Ivanov et al. (arXiv:1811.10997), JCAP. New observed 95% CL upper limit on the axion-photon coupling of ultralight ALP dark matter from non-observation of periodic EVPA oscillations in MOJAVE VLBA 15 GHz polarization monitoring of parsec-scale AGN jets. The abstract and conclusions quote the limit as g_agamma <~ 1e-12 GeV^-1 over 5e-23 eV < m < 1.2e-21 eV; the exact mass-dependent curve (Fig. 6, ranging roughly 3e-13 to 1e-11 GeV^-1) is only available graphically, so a flat two-point representation at the quoted level over the stated mass range is emitted. IMPORTANT: dm_density_assumed = 20 GeV/cm^3 is NOT the local Milky Way density; it is the assumed DM density at the AGN source (kappa = rho_DM/20 GeV/cm^3, limits scale as kappa^1/2).
